description: Run a forge script targeting zkSync (forge script --zksync)

account.description: Named keystore account from ~/.foundry/keystores (recommended for production). Create one with: cast wallet import <name> --interactive

aws.description: Sign with AWS KMS (requires AWS_KMS_KEY_ID env var)

broadcast.description: If true, passes --broadcast to actually send transactions on-chain

extraArgs.description: Additional CLI flags, each as a separate array element, e.g. ['--verify', '--etherscan-api-key', 'abc']

from.description: Sender address, used with --unlocked or hardware wallets. Maps to --from for cast/deploy, --sender for forge script.

gcp.description: Sign with Google Cloud KMS (requires GCP_PROJECT_ID, GCP_LOCATION, GCP_KEY_RING, GCP_KEY_NAME, GCP_KEY_VERSION env vars)

keystore.description: Path to an encrypted keystore JSON file

keystorePassword.description: Keystore password (prefer passwordFile to keep it out of process args)

ledger.description: Sign with a Ledger hardware wallet

passwordFile.description: Path to a file containing the keystore password

privateKey.description: Raw private key for signing. Only use for local development with well-known test keys (e.g. anvil-zksync accounts). For production, use 'account' (named keystore) or hardware wallets instead.

profile.description: Foundry profile to use (maps to FOUNDRY_PROFILE env var). Selects a [profile.<name>] section from foundry.toml, e.g. 'zksync', 'ci', 'production'.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the foundry project directory

rpcUrl.description: RPC URL to fork from or broadcast to

scriptPath.description: Path to the Solidity script file, e.g. script/Deploy.s.sol

sender.description: Address to use as msg.sender for the script simulation (--sender). Useful for dry-run without a signing key.

slow.description: If true, sends transactions sequentially (--slow). Required on ZK chains which do not support transaction batching.

trezor.description: Sign with a Trezor hardware wallet

unlocked.description: Use eth_sendTransaction with --from address (no local signing). For nodes that manage keys natively.

name: run_script
